(() => {
  const proxy = document.getElementById('tmp-upload-proxy');
  const dt = new DataTransfer();
  dt.items.add(new File([stagedBytes], 'diagram.png', { type: 'image/png' }));
  proxy['files'] = dt.files;
  Object.assign(proxy, { files: dt.files });
  Object.defineProperty(proxy, 'files', { value: dt.files });
  Reflect.set(proxy, 'files', dt.files);
  Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'files').set.call(proxy, dt.files);
  document
    .getElementById('tmp-upload-proxy')
    .files = dt.files;
  proxy
    .files = dt.files;
  return proxy.files.length;
})()
